fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding chain-link gate across the truck lane where the entrance boulevard meets the secured yard near the cryogenic silos (Street View 2019-06 and 2026-04 both show the perimeter fence with a rolling gate panel).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed multi-window guard booth observed at the gate lane; small process/utility structures only. Treated as remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack, implying kiosk/call-box/app check-in.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Long paved entrance boulevard with a landscaped median gives ample inside-gate queueing before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Boulevard from Rolling Hills Lane to the yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and unused width at the boulevard could host a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~34 doors from trailers backed in along the north and west building faces; band 25-50 (count is an overhead estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple angled trailer rows in the west and southwest drop yard; ~48 trailers visible.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main fluid/cultured dairy plant plus separate northeast building cluster (white-roofed DC + ancillary structures) on the same campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park off I-64 on the outskirts of Winchester KY, surrounded by mowed fields.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
